regions.name: South India
visual_identifiers: Dravidian temple architecture with gopuram towers
specific South Indian script on signs
specific South Indian auto rickshaw colors by state

state_distinguishers.Tamil_Nadu: Tamil script on signs. Yellow and black auto rickshaws. Specific temple architecture.
state_distinguishers.Kerala: Malayalam script. Green lush backwaters. Specific Kerala house style with sloped roofs.
state_distinguishers.Karnataka: Kannada script. Bangalore tech infrastructure visible near city.
state_distinguishers.Andhra_Telangana: Telugu script. Red soil. Specific infrastructure.

regions.route_sign_clues: Sign language is the most reliable identifier. Tamil = Tamil Nadu. Malayalam = Kerala. Kannada = Karnataka. Telugu = AP/Telangana.
regions.gemini_hint: Script on signs is THE most reliable identifier in India. Tamil script = Tamil Nadu. Malayalam curved script = Kerala. Coconut palms + specific script = South India confirmed.

regions.name: North India Plains
visual_identifiers: specific North Indian truck art styles

state_distinguishers.Rajasthan: Desert terrain, sand dunes, specific Rajasthani architecture, camel carts possible.
state_distinguishers.Punjab: More prosperous farming, specific house styles, Gurmukhi script visible alongside Hindi.
state_distinguishers.UP_vs_Bihar: UP slightly more developed. Bihar more rural. Difficult to distinguish.

regions.route_sign_clues: NH prefix for national highways. State routes use UP, BR, RJ etc prefixes.
regions.gemini_hint: Sand dunes + desert + Rajasthani architecture = Rajasthan. Gurmukhi script alongside Hindi = Punjab. Flat dusty plain with Hindi signs = Gangetic plains (UP, Bihar).

regions.name: West India
visual_identifiers: Marathi or Gujarati script on signs

state_distinguishers.Goa: Portuguese colonial architecture is unmistakable. White churches. Specific laterite stone. Very distinctive.
state_distinguishers.Maharashtra_vs_Gujarat: Marathi script vs Gujarati script on signs. Mumbai suburban infrastructure distinctive.
state_distinguishers.Gujarat: Gujarati script. Specific house decoration styles. Dry terrain in Kutch.

regions.gemini_hint: Portuguese church architecture + laterite stone = Goa almost certainly. Gujarati script on signs = Gujarat.

regions.name: Northeast India
visual_identifiers: looks more Southeast Asian than rest of India
specific Northeast Indian facial features on people

state_distinguishers.Assam: Tea garden rows very distinctive. Brahmaputra river visible. Specific Assamese architecture.
state_distinguishers.Meghalaya_Sikkim: Very green misty hills. Looks almost like Switzerland in places.
state_distinguishers.Manipur_Nagaland: More remote hill terrain. Specific tribal architectural elements.

regions.route_sign_clues: NH routes. English script more common here than Hindi.
regions.gemini_hint: Tea garden rows = Assam almost certainly. Misty green hills with almost Swiss feel = Meghalaya or Sikkim.

regions.name: Central and East India
visual_identifiers: dense forest areas in MP and Chhattisgarh
West Bengal: Bengali script on signs
Kolkata: specific colonial and modern mix

state_distinguishers.West_Bengal: Bengali script on signs is very distinctive. Kolkata infrastructure.
state_distinguishers.Odisha: Odishan script on signs. Specific temple architecture.
state_distinguishers.MP_vs_Chhattisgarh: Very similar. Dense forest. Difficult to distinguish.

regions.route_sign_clues: WB (West Bengal), OD (Odisha), MP, CG prefixes.
regions.gemini_hint: Bengali script = West Bengal. Odishan script = Odisha. Dense sal forest = Central India tribal belt.
